changes.reason: Require existing activation evidence before a Redis journal claim; discard stale delivery-index members while retaining durable intent/backlog entries and lease/retry scheduling. No public shape, stored entry format or runtime claim changes.

kubernetes.reason: Redis Lua claim gating is reused through the existing RedisClient; no Node Host or Kubernetes cluster execution was performed.
constraints: Requires persistent Redis and atomic multi-key Lua; local container conformance is not cluster certification.

aws-lambda.reason: The same RedisClient and server-time Lua are reused; no Lambda invocation/host execution was performed.
constraints: Applications must await journal operations within invocation budgets; Redis connection/lifecycle ownership remains with the existing adapter.

cloudflare.reason: No Workers or Node Container host execution is established by this Redis Lua fix.
constraints: An independently compatible RedisClient and multi-key Lua service are required; the existing Upstash package does not claim Workers support.
